hindi: बिन्दु $P\left(1,\dfrac{1}{2}\right)$ से अतिपरवलय $\dfrac{x^{2}}{4}-\dfrac{y^{2}}{3}=1$ पर स्पर्श रेखाएँ खींची जाती हैं। माना दोनों स्पर्श बिन्दुओं को मिलाने वाली जीवा का मध्य बिन्दु $(\alpha,\beta)$ है। तब $\alpha+\beta$ बराबर है
solution: $2\beta=\dfrac{2\beta^{2}}{3}\Rightarrow\beta=3,\ \alpha=6$ ($\beta=0$ would give $\alpha=0$, the centre, which is not on $3x-2y=12$)
solution_full: For $P(1,\tfrac12)$, $S_{1}=\dfrac{1}{4}-\dfrac{1}{12}-1=-\dfrac{5}{6}<0$. For $y=mx+c$ through $P$ the tangency condition $c^{2}=4m^{2}-3$ gives a quadratic in $m$ with discriminant proportional to $-S_{1}>0$, so two real tangents can be drawn.
The chord of contact of $P(x_{1},y_{1})$ is $T=0$: $\dfrac{x x_{1}}{4}-\dfrac{y y_{1}}{3}=1$, i.e. $\dfrac{x}{4}-\dfrac{y}{6}=1$, or $3x-2y=12$.
The chord of the hyperbola whose mid-point is $(\alpha,\beta)$ is $T=S_{1}$: $\dfrac{\alpha x}{4}-\dfrac{\beta y}{3}=\dfrac{\alpha^{2}}{4}-\dfrac{\beta^{2}}{3}$.
These are the same line, so comparing with $3x-2y=12$: $\dfrac{\alpha}{4\cdot3}=\dfrac{\beta}{3\cdot2}=\dfrac{1}{12}\left(\dfrac{\alpha^{2}}{4}-\dfrac{\beta^{2}}{3}\right)$.
The first equality gives $\alpha=2\beta$. The second gives $\alpha=\dfrac{\alpha^{2}}{4}-\dfrac{\beta^{2}}{3}=\beta^{2}-\dfrac{\beta^{2}}{3}=\dfrac{2\beta^{2}}{3}$.
So $2\beta=\dfrac{2\beta^{2}}{3}$, giving $\beta=3$ (the value $\beta=0$ gives the centre $(0,0)$, which does not lie on $3x-2y=12$). Then $\alpha=6$; check: $3\cdot6-2\cdot3=12$.
Direct check: $3x-2y=12$ meets the hyperbola at $x=6\pm\sqrt{10}$, whose mean is $6$.
Hence $\alpha+\beta=9$. Option (B) is the coordinate sum of $P$ itself.
originality_note: New: the chord of contact of a given external point is re-read as a chord with an unknown mid-point, and the mid-point is recovered by matching T = 0 with T = S1 (way 5). Closest known: chord of a hyperbola bisected at a given point; chord of contact from a given point. Different because: the mid-point is the unknown and is obtained from the chord of contact, not the reverse.

concept_use.Chord whose mid point is given for Hyper: The chord with mid-point (alpha, beta) is written as T = S1 and compared with the chord of contact to get alpha = 2 beta and beta = 3.
concept_use.Chord of contact for Hyperbola: The chord of contact of P(1, 1/2) is T = 0, i.e. 3x - 2y = 12; the existence of the two tangents is checked from S1 < 0.
